about_the_game:
The Pilgrim War is the official Expansion for the praised turnbased strategy game Rising Lords and expands on the exciting battles with new unit from a new nation. A new story awaits, new maps are a given and allows your nation for the first to use science to specialize even further!

Welcome to the Kingdoms of Atra!

The southern Kingdoms of Atra are well known for their terrifying armies. The magnificent cities with their golden roofs, their wide gardens and their massive stone walls are witnesses of their craft and hunger for wisdom. They are the Atras! Nobody can oppose them. Well. But the world has changed.

A fragile peace will always cause a war!

Since forever there has been a dispute among the Knights of the North with the South over religion. And yet a fragile peace allowed pilgrims from both sides to visit the holy city. When a massive invasion fleet arrives ashore, young prince Matek and his small principality have to defend themselves at all costs. The threat becomes unbearable but help comes from an unexpected side.

Fresh content for experienced players!

Time has come to call for war again and create massive armies once again. The nation of Atra awaits with new units you can discover. Science expands the tactical and strategic options, not only for the Atras but also for your well known Knights. Unlock new advantages to define and redefine your own playstiles. Use it to gain a benefit in front of your countless enemies. All new content is of course also available for Multiplayer Sessions with your friends. And yes, of course you can also create your own Adventures for the South with the Editor!

Features:

  • The nation of Atra awaits and is ready for war while offering new and unique mechanics

  • Explore the Southlands, a new region which has been in a religious dispute with the Knights of the north since forever

  • 7 new units to increase the complexity of the turn based battles even further and introduce an asymmetric balance

  • Sciences allows you to unlock new advantages and specialisation

  • New Items, Cards, Avatars and more fitting for the new setting
